subject.title: feat: add editable voice dictation to the Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw keep this Gateway-backed editable Control UI dictation direction alive and require a port to the current chat composer, or close/defer it behind the broader provider-backed voice tracker?
rationale: The code is a meaningful implementation candidate but now misses the current UI owner boundary and adds a new microphone-to-Gateway STT product boundary that automation should not accept without maintainer direction.

options.title: Keep Gateway-backed dictation, require port and proof
options.body: Ask for a current `ui/src/pages/chat` port, the alert accessibility fix, green docs/checks, and redacted real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Defer behind the broad voice tracker
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers want to settle WebChat voice UX through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/45508 before accepting a narrow dictation path.

options.title: Choose another voice input direction
options.body: If realtime Talk or another architecture should own composer voice input, document that direction and reject this branch as the wrong permanent shape.

recommendation.title: Keep Gateway-backed dictation, require port and proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a current `ui/src/pages/chat` port, the alert accessibility fix, green docs/checks, and redacted real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest feature-history signal for prior Gateway-backed dictation and adjacent WebChat voice work, while current UI porting would also need current-page owner input.
